title: Last Call for Prime Day Deals on Two Shark Vacuums I Love
gist: WIRED's Nena Farrell recommends two Shark vacuum deals on the last day of Amazon's Prime Big Deal Days: the PowerDetect cordless stick at $300 and the PowerDetect UV Reveal robot at $750 (42% off). This is an affiliate-style deal post.

insights.claim: The Shark PowerDetect UV Reveal robot vacuum fell to $750 from $1,300 (42% off) and uses a UV light to spot stains and go back to clean them; the author calls it the best robot vacuum she has tried and notes this is the lowest price typically seen.
insights.speaker: Nena Farrell
insights.so_what: Reference price point for the premium robot vacuum segment.
insights.quote: This is the best robot vacuum I've tried

insights.claim: The Shark PowerDetect Cordless Stick Vacuum dropped to $300 (28% off) at Amazon; the author says it performed best in her tests against her favorite Dyson and Bosch's new vacuum and prefers it to the newer, non-discounted PowerDetect Speed for this sale.
insights.speaker: Nena Farrell
insights.so_what: Shark positions as the value alternative to Dyson in stick vacuums.

insights.claim: The author argues that Shark is the way to go over on-sale Dyson models if one wants to spend less and still get something super powerful.
insights.speaker: Nena Farrell
insights.so_what: Editorial stance favoring Shark over Dyson on value.
